command: node collect-perf.mjs https://saam-s-store.vercel.app/ https://saam-s-store.vercel.app/shop https://saam-s-store.vercel.app/products/apple https://saam-s-store.vercel.app/cart --runs 3 --profile mobile,desktop

findings.title: 3 web font file(s), 89 kB, text hidden while they load
findings.evidence:
https://saam-s-store.vercel.app/_next/static/media/ce62453a442c7f35-s.p.0a0h245ktd4x0.woff2 — 37 kB
https://saam-s-store.vercel.app/_next/static/media/ccee61546c0358b7-s.42l_3z3944ji5.woff2 — 17 kB
https://saam-s-store.vercel.app/_next/static/media/fad568eea626db0e-s.0fd-fjxmcxcjd.woff2 — 36 kB
1 font face(s) use font-display: auto, which hides text until the font arrives.
findings.impact: Each font weight is a separate download on the critical path. Where font-display is not set to swap, the browser shows nothing where the text should be — for up to three seconds on a slow connection.
findings.fix: Set `font-display: swap`, self-host rather than loading from a third-party origin, preload only the one or two faces used above the fold, and drop weights the design does not actually use.

findings.title: Main content takes too long to appear (LCP 2.75 s)
findings.evidence: LCP 2.75 s — median of 3 cold loads, Moto G-class Android, 4G. Threshold for "good" is 2.50 s.
findings.impact: On Moto G-class Android, 4G, the largest thing on screen finishes drawing after 2.75 s. Google treats anything over 2.5 seconds as poor; it affects both search ranking and how many visitors leave before the page is usable.
findings.fix: Identify the LCP element (recorded in perf.json as `lcpElement`) and shorten its path: serve it at the size it is displayed, in a modern format, without waiting on JavaScript or a render-blocking stylesheet.
